card.title: PANZER II-A
card.flavorText: Panzer II is a name used for a series of German tanks used in WWII, and PANZER II-A, or Panzerkampfwagen II Ausf.A (Sd.Kfz.121), was one of the early models in these series. It had an armament of a 2 cm Kw.K.30 gun and had a crew of 3 (commander/gunner, driver, loader). The tank played an important role in the Polish and French Campaigns, but was also used in North Africa and on the Eastern Front.
